title: Replace hard-coded spacing with design tokens
prompt: Our components use ad-hoc pixel paddings, margins and gaps (p-3 next to p-5 style drift). Replace every padding, margin and gap value in styles/components/*.css with the spacing tokens defined in styles/tokens.css (var(--space-1) ... var(--space-6)), picking the nearest token for each value. Do not change tokens.css. Values of 0 may stay 0.
